name: Cachapas
steps: Pulse corn kernels with milk just until a coarse, spoonable batter forms; leave some kernels intact.
Mix in cornmeal, sugar and salt. Rest 10 minutes so the cornmeal absorbs moisture.
Melt a little butter in a medium-hot pan. Spoon one quarter of the batter into a thick 16 cm round and cook 4–5 minutes until the base is deep golden and the top begins to set.
Flip carefully and cook 3–4 minutes. Add one quarter of the cheese, fold in half and warm 1 minute until the cheese softens. Repeat for four.
Serve hot while the edges are golden and the center remains tender.
tips: Fresh corn provides the sweet flavor and coarse texture; do not puree it smooth.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
